description: Copy and rebrand the sellnetic_booking module as medbook_booking into PrestaShop's modules/ directory. Rename all namespaces from Sellnetic\Booking to MedBook\Booking, rename table prefixes from sellnetic_booking_ to medbook_, rename all class references, service IDs, route names, and the module main class. Lock resource_type default to 'doctor'. Update all text to Polish (pl-PL) where applicable.
steps: Rename the main module file from sellnetic_booking.php to medbook_booking.php
Rename the main class from Sellnetic_booking to Medbook_booking (PS module class naming convention: filename without .php, with underscores)
Update the module constructor: name='medbook_booking', displayName='MedBook - Rezerwacja Wizyt', description='Platforma do rezerwacji wizyt lekarskich', version='1.0.0', author='MedBook'
Replace all PHP namespace references: Sellnetic\Booking -> MedBook\Booking throughout all src/ files
Update config/services.yml: change all Sellnetic\Booking\ references to MedBook\Booking\, update service IDs from sellnetic_booking.* to medbook_booking.*
Update config/admin/services.yml: same namespace and service ID replacements

Update config/routes.yml: rename all route names from admin_sellnetic_booking_* to admin_medbook_booking_*, update controller FQCNs, update _legacy_controller and _legacy_link values from AdminSellneticBooking* to AdminMedbookBooking*

Update sql/install.sql: rename all table names from PREFIX_sellnetic_booking_* to PREFIX_medbook_*, rename all index names from idx_sellnetic_booking_* to idx_medbook_*. Change resource_type default from 'service' to 'doctor'
Update sql/uninstall.sql with new table names (PREFIX_medbook_*)
Update sql/upgrade-*.sql files with new table names
Rename all Grid class references (GridDefinitionFactory, QueryBuilder, Filters) to use medbook_ table names and medbook_booking grid IDs
Update all Entity classes to reference medbook_ tables instead of sellnetic_booking_ tables
Update the getTabs() method in the main module class: rename all class_name values from AdminSellneticBooking* to AdminMedbookBooking*, update route_name values to admin_medbook_booking_*
Update views/templates/admin/ twig templates to reference new route names (admin_medbook_booking_*)
Update controllers/front/*.php controller class names from Sellnetic_bookingModuleFrontController derivatives to Medbook_bookingModuleFrontController pattern (or use appropriate PS9 naming)
Update composer.json in the module (if present) with new namespace autoload mapping
Update all hook references and translation domains: Modules.Sellneticbooking.* -> Modules.Medbookbooking.*

Add Polish translations for all admin labels in the module: Booking->Rezerwacje, Resources->Lekarze, Schedule->Harmonogram, Blocked Dates->Zablokowane Terminy, Price Rules->Reguly Cenowe, Add-ons->Dodatki, Settings->Ustawienia, Calendar->Kalendarz, Recurring->Wizyty Cykliczne, Waitlist->Lista Oczekujacych, Refund Rules->Reguly Zwrotow, Deposit Rules->Reguly Zaliczek
acceptance_criteria: No references to 'sellnetic' or 'Sellnetic' remain in any file within modules/medbook_booking/
All PHP files pass syntax check (php -l)
Module main class is properly named Medbook_booking in medbook_booking.php
All service IDs in services.yml use medbook_booking prefix
All route names in routes.yml use admin_medbook_booking_ prefix
SQL install creates tables with medbook_ prefix
verification: Run: find /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/ -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \; | grep -v 'No syntax errors' to verify no PHP syntax errors
Run: grep -ri 'sellnetic' /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/ to verify no old references remain
Run: grep "resource_type.*DEFAULT.*doctor" /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/sql/install.sql to confirm doctor default
